name: geometer-pathway-fees
description: Fee and dues collection for tuition and coaching centres: a monthly reminder with a payment link in the parent's language, 'never a reminder once paid' judged from the payment record, waivers and refunds that ask the owner. Runs as a server (one SQLite file per centre, a signed-webhook inbox, an approvals relay for refunds Guard holds, a go-live certificate and a monthly report), checked against stand-in services. No dependencies.
